svg.title: The King's Room — Road-oath throne
svg.desc: A broad audience floor ends at the oath dais. The council table and diplomatic balcony create quiet secondary routes around the throne. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: A broad audience floor ends at the oath dais. The council table and diplomatic balcony
